facts.statement: The harness reads PNG info, updates info, allocates a row buffer, calls png_start_read_image, then calls png_read_row for each row and pass before png_read_end. A width and height product check can return before row reading.

If PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT is set, png_start_read_image calls png_app_error with a duplicate-call report. If the flag is clear, it calls png_read_start_row. This contract is supplied for both source versions.

On successful completion, png_read_start_row claims the IDAT inflate stream and sets PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT. A later png_start_read_image call would therefore take the duplicate-call branch if png_read_update_info had already completed this initialization.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows when the earlier row initialization sets the flag.
Shows the same flag setting in the after source.

facts.statement: The harness installs a setjmp handler before png_start_read_image. If png_app_error longjumps there, the handler cleans up and returns before the row loop; the supplied lines do not establish whether png_app_error warns or longjumps in this setup.

evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the harness recovery path for an error.
Orders png_start_read_image before every row call.

facts.statement: When PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT is clear, png_start_read_image provides a row initialization route through png_read_start_row.
Within the complete supplied harness unit, every png_read_row call is in the loop after png_start_read_image; it contains no route that skips that call and still reads rows.
The complete harness unit contains input gates and cleanup checks but no assertion that row decoding completed.

The supplied build recipe disables STDIO, WARNING and WRITE options, runs configure without explicit arguments, builds libpng16.la, and links the read fuzzer. The complete recipe does not set PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN.
